messages:
alexg: Quick poll — how do we want to handle schema evolution for the internal inference-routing API? We have REST clients, internal gRPC services, and a few gateway translation options on the table. My initial thought: proto-first for services, gateway that exposes REST for external teams. Pros/cons?

sarah: Proto-first + gRPC between services sounds right to me. Strong typing, smaller payloads, easier to enforce contracts.

kevin: Agree on proto for S2S, but big :warning: about gateway translation. It can silently mutate semantics (headers, defaults). Also quotas/telemetry get messy if gateway hides the canonical method.

jenny: Also add: proto evolution rules — additive fields only, reserve tags, avoid changing semantics of existing fields. That reduces need for breaking changes.

alexg: Question: do we want the gateway to be a dumb proxy (just transcode) or a canonical contract enforcer (validate and reject incompatible changes at edge)?

kevin: Canonical enforcer. If gateway can validate proto compatibility and fail fast, we avoid many runtime surprises. Put checks in CI too so PRs are blocked early.

sarah: For external REST clients, grpc-gateway or autogenerated REST surface from proto seems easiest. Teams get regular REST, we keep proto as source-of-truth. But streaming and some header semantics don't map cleanly.

jenny: grpc-gateway is fine for 80%, but watch streaming & long-poll endpoints. Also: telemetry — gateway must emit mapping to canonical RPC name so Console can show per-route SLOs/costs.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rolling out grpc-gateway v0.3 to staging — canary at 1% traffic.

alexg: Migration plan idea: 1) proto-first (proto repo + lint rules), 2) gateway translation for parity, 3) deprecate direct REST after 6 months if telemetry looks good, 4) provide adapters for legacy internal clients. Thoughts?

kevin: +1. Also require per-route quotas + circuit-breakers in gateway with fallback to lower-cost async path if overloaded. That keeps latency SLOs intact.

sarah: :thumbsup: And add rollout metrics in Console: latency, 5xx rate, token-cost per call. Those should gate moving from canary -> ramp.

jenny: I'll draft an RFC with example proto patterns and CI proto-lint rules. Will include rules for reserved tags and oneof usage. Ping me any edge cases you want included.

alexg: Cool — I'll open the RFC and include a sample proto snippet to show safe evolution patterns:
```proto
message RouteRequest {
  string request_id = 1;
  repeated string features = 2;
  // new optional fields should be high tag numbers to avoid collisions
  string routing_hint = 10;
}
```

kevin: One more: gateway must preserve original tracing headers (x-trace-id, span ids) and attach canonical RPC metadata. Otherwise traces link poorly and debugging is painful.

incident-bot: incident-bot: FYI the routing config rollout last week caused a small spike in 503s for ~8m in prod. Recommend canary + rollback thresholds.

alexg: Good catch — add canary policy: 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic rollback on >0.5% 5xx increase vs baseline. We'll bake that into the RFC.

jenny: I'll include the canary policy + CI checks in the RFC draft. Expect PR by EOD tomorrow.

alexg: Thanks everyone — keeping this lightweight for now. We'll iterate in the RFC.
